receives a ~Rs 306 cr Letter of Award (ex-GST) from Puravankara for a residential project at Estrella, Andheri West, Mumbai

movers.quantum: Rs 4,931 cr combined (our arithmetic); mcap n/a
movers.headline: Board revises the Phase-1 anode-project cost to ~Rs 2,350 cr, approves a 24,000 MT expansion at ~Rs 1,606 cr, a Rs 475 cr crucible plant and a Rs 500 cr graphene plant

order_wins: **Affordable Robotic & Automation** -- subsidiary ARAPL RaaS (Humro) bags its largest single order, US$5.47 mn (~Rs 51.8 cr) for 103 robots from an undisclosed international customer _(~19% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.
**RattanIndia Enterprises** -- wholly owned Revolt Motors secures an order for 1,100 BlazeX electric motorcycles from Bihar Police for patrolling; the press release states no value.

**Bharat Heavy Electricals** -- receives orders from Adani Power for boiler-turbine-generator supply and services for four projects of 2x800 MW each; the value sits in the annexure and is not stated in the pages read.

**GE Vernova T&D India** -- receives Power Grid's Letter of Award (3 Nov) for the 6,000 MW, +/-800 kV HVDC terminal station (Barmer II to South Kalamb), converting its 7-Sep L1 status; no value stated.
**Anondita Medicare** -- receives an additional purchase order from Central Medical Services Society (Health Ministry) for condoms; the value is not in the pages read.
**Trom Industries** -- Rs 3.21 cr purchase order from Zydus Pharmaceuticals for a 1 MW rooftop solar plant _(~6.0% of mcap, SME)_.
**Abha Power and Steel** -- Rs 1.57 cr order from a Railway OEM; order book about Rs 21 cr _(~4.0% of mcap, SME)_.
**Zenith Drugs** -- Rs 1.24 cr (incl. GST) Rajasthan Medical Services Corporation LOA for 2.27 lakh units of pregabalin capsules _(~2.0% of mcap)_.

**Som Distilleries & Breweries** -- Carlsberg India extends its contract-manufacturing agreement at the Odisha facility by three years; disclosed voluntarily as below the materiality threshold, no value stated.
**Markolines Pavement Technologies** -- files a work-order intimation dated November 2026; the filing text is not in the cache, so counterparty and value are unread.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Rossell Techsys** -- allots 25,72,898 equity shares at Rs 1,166 for Rs 299.99 cr cash on a preferential basis, executing the raise approved 18-Sep _(~5.7% of mcap)_.

**Cubex Tubings** -- tells the exchanges how a proposed preferential issue of up to 50,00,000 warrants at Rs 150 (up to Rs 75 cr) will avoid an open-offer trigger, ahead of the 6-Nov EGM; a proposal, not executed.
**AJC Jewel Manufacturers** -- will issue up to 5,67,491 equity shares at Rs 169.85 (about Rs 9.64 cr, our arithmetic), one share fewer than the 29-Sep approval; subject to in-principle approval.
**Manoj Ceramic** -- BSE in-principle approval for 2,50,000 compulsorily convertible preference shares at Rs 100 to promoters (Rs 2.5 cr, our arithmetic), convertible 1:1 into equity.
**Organic Recycling Systems** -- allots 10,00,000 equity shares at Rs 161 (Rs 16.10 cr) in cash to promoter Sarang Bhand on a preferential basis _(~4.7% of mcap)_.
equity_allotments: **Diana Tea Company** -- allots 40,74,075 convertible warrants at Rs 27 (about Rs 11.0 cr, our arithmetic) to promoters and promoter group after receiving 25% of the price; new warrants, new capital.
**Wardwizard Healthcare** -- allots 1,08,70,000 convertible warrants at Rs 10 to promoter and non-promoter allottees after receiving Rs 2.72 cr (25%); new warrants, convertible within 18 months.

**Raymond Realty** -- allots 66,57,373 convertible warrants on a preferential basis to J K Investors (Bombay) Limited, executing the raise approved at the 8-Oct EGM; issue price not in the pages read.
**Kiri Industries** -- receives in-principle approval from BSE and NSE for 60,82,600 warrants to promoters and promoter group; a stage before allotment.
**P.M. Telelinnks** -- BSE in-principle approval for a preferential issue of 1,50,00,000 shares at Rs 10, about Rs 15 cr (our arithmetic); a stage before allotment.
**Tembo Global Industries** -- NSE lists 40,50,000 shares issued to promoters on conversion of warrants; past warrant conversion.
**Dhansafal Finserve** -- BSE listing approval for 1,00,00,000 shares at a Rs 3.31 premium issued to promoters on warrant conversion; past warrant conversion.
**Abhinav Leasing & Finance** -- Board approves allotment of 6,00,00,000 convertible warrants at Re 1 each (Rs 6 cr) to non-promoter entities _(~109% of mcap)_.
**Datakosa** -- BSE listing approval for 20,58,822 shares issued at Rs 17 (about Rs 3.5 cr, our arithmetic) to non-promoters; execution of an already disclosed raise.
**Krishival Foods** -- 5,51,289 partly paid shares converted to fully paid after the rights issue and began trading on 2-Nov; completion of an earlier raise.
m_and_a: **Creative Newtech** -- Board approves buying 100% of Zicom SaaS for about Rs 50.50 cr enterprise value: Rs 25.50 cr by swapping 2,25,000 new shares with Onyx SaaS, Rs 25 cr in cash; subject to approvals _(~2.8% of mcap)_.
**5paisa Capital** -- acquires 66,148 more Giskard Datatech shares by share swap on 3-Nov, lifting its stake from 19.76% to 57.41% and making it a subsidiary; completes the 28-Jul deal.

**Somany Ceramics** -- Board approves buying up to 24,75,000 shares (25%) of subsidiary Somany Sanitary Ware from existing shareholders, raising its stake from 51% to up to 76%; price not in the pages read.
**Bansal Roofing Products** -- Board approves subscribing to fresh equity to hold 79.959% of Durapuf Insutech Panels, which becomes a subsidiary on completion; consideration not stated.

**Delaplex** -- completes, through its UK subsidiary, the acquisition of 100% of Bisham Limited and Bisham Consulting (UK logistics and warehouse-management consulting); price not in the press release.
**JK Paper** -- acquired 3,27,604 shares (5.46%) of Quadragen Vethealth and is acquiring a further 92,396 (1.54%), taking its stake to 72.00%.

**Sundaram Finance** -- Board approves buying 100% of Sundaram Alternate Assets from its own subsidiary Sundaram AMC, an intra-group transfer subject to regulatory approvals; price not in the pages read.
**Narayana Hrudayalaya** -- NCLT Bengaluru sanctions the Scheme of Arrangement between NH Integrated Care and the company; consideration not in the pages read.
**NDL Ventures** -- receives the final NCLT order approving the merger by absorption of Hinduja Leyland Finance into NDL Ventures (formerly NXTDIGITAL).
**S A Tech Software India** -- NCLT Mumbai order of 3-Nov on the Scheme of Amalgamation of Mindpool Technologies into the company.
**Clio Infotech** -- Board approves a scheme to merge Webdlues Infotech and Codezeros Technology into the company by absorption.

**Shanti Educational Initiatives** -- Board modifies its composite scheme so the transferor's intellectual property is retained and vests in the amalgamated company rather than moving in the slump sale.
**Sahasra Electronic Solutions** -- NSE issues its no-objection letter for the amalgamation of three group companies into Sahasra Electronic Solutions.
**Belding India** -- Board keeps in abeyance the draft amalgamation of DC&T Global into Belding India announced 30-Jul.
**Jindal Poly Films** -- step-down UK subsidiary JPF API Laminates UK is dissolved via JPF Netherlands Investment B.V.
**Abans Enterprises** -- Board approves voluntary liquidation of material wholly owned subsidiary Abans Gems & Jewels Trading FZC, subject to shareholder approval.
capex_core: **Premier Energies** -- Board notes subsidiary PEGEPL's approved Rs 5,947 cr budget for a 10 GW ingot and wafer facility at Naidupeta, Andhra Pradesh; the 5 GW first phase is due 31-Dec-2027.
**Sat Kartar Life** -- files a capacity-addition intimation titled as a proposal for a new hospital at Jaipur; filing text is not in the cache, so scale and cost are unread.
business_updates: **Results season** — 631 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.
**Credo Brands Marketing (Mufti)** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 16% to Rs 189.3 cr, EBITDA up 24% to Rs 59.5 cr and PAT up 45% to Rs 27.3 cr; 419 exclusive stores at 30-Sep.
**Systematic Industries** -- H1 FY27 total revenue Rs 312.3 cr versus Rs 255.8 cr a year earlier, up about 22% (from the figures saved for this filing; its text is not in the cache).

**Allied Blenders and Distillers** -- highest-ever monthly sales volumes for two straight months, over 3.5 million cases in September and over 3.6 million in October 2026; Officer's Choice Brandy and Sumo Whisky pass a million cases each.
**Angel One** -- October client base 40.60 mn (up 17.4% YoY, our arithmetic on the filing's columns), orders 139.31 mn (+4.2% YoY); F&O notional ADTO Rs 53,149 bn, down 7.6% YoY.
**Max Estates** -- Q2 FY27 pre-sales Rs 2,092 cr (about 14x YoY), taking H1 FY27 pre-sales to Rs 3,184 cr.
**PDS Limited** -- Q2 FY27 revenue a record Rs 4,432 cr, up 29% on Q1, with PAT up 144% on Q1.
**Redington** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 48% to Rs 43,002 crore.
**EPL** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 30% with all regions growing double digits; Beauty & Cosmetics up 42.9%.
**Steel Exchange India** -- Q2 FY27 PAT about Rs 18 cr versus Rs 2.11 cr a year ago on revenue up 46% to Rs 340 cr; Rs 102 cr of debt cut.
**Orkla India** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 19.4% and PAT up 19.2%.
**Varroc Engineering** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 2,947.9 cr (Rs 29,479 mn), up 33.6% YoY; PBT before exceptional items and JV profit Rs 140.1 cr (Rs 1,401 mn) versus Rs 91.2 cr.
**Websol Energy System** -- Q2 FY27 PAT up 73% YoY to Rs 80 cr on revenue more than doubling to Rs 361 cr.
**JM Financial** -- Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs 1,056 cr and PAT Rs 240 cr; interim dividend Rs 1.65 a share.
**Aimtron Electronics** -- H1 FY27 revenue up 83% and net profit up 72% YoY per its revised post-results release.
**Lenskart Solutions** -- Q2 FY27 revenue up 32.5% to Rs 2,845 cr, PAT 2.1x to Rs 232 cr; H1 revenue Rs 5,559 cr.

**Northern Arc Capital** -- subsidiary Northern Arc Investment Managers says its Diversified Debt Fund has raised over Rs 400 cr toward a Rs 1,500 cr target plus a Rs 500 cr greenshoe; a fund-management milestone, not the company's own raise.
**OnEMI Technology Solutions (Kissht)** -- AUM crosses Rs 10,000 cr, per its press release.
distress_risk: **Quasar India** -- NCLT New Delhi admits a Section 9 IBC application and initiates CIRP against the company (order of 31-Oct).
**Reliance Communications** -- SBI's review committee rejects the company's representations and will report it to credit bureaus as a wilful defaulter.
**Asian Star Company** -- Income Tax Department levies a Rs 16.13 cr penalty under Section 271G (order of 28-Sep).

**Tenneco Clean Air India** -- Maharashtra stamp collector's final order reconfirms Rs 12.85 cr stamp duty and raises the penalty to Rs 24.36 cr on the 2019 demerger order; the company will contest it.
**Rashi Peripherals** -- customs order confirms Rs 2.15 cr (Rs 1.08 cr duty plus an equal penalty) and drops Rs 0.87 cr of the demand.
**Le Travenues Technology (ixigo)** -- NFAC partly allows its AY 2022-23 tax appeal, granting relief on Rs 29.53 cr of Rs 46.25 cr additions; the Rs 19.29 cr demand is expected to fall substantially.
**Gufic Biosciences** -- ITAT sets aside the CIT(A) findings on its AY 2023-24 assessment (original demand Rs 11.89 cr) and sends the matter back to the Assessing Officer.
**Greenlam Industries** -- Himachal Pradesh High Court quashes the Rs 7.68 cr GST show-cause notice; no financial impact.
**Goenka Business & Finance** -- demat accounts unfrozen after the Securities Appellate Tribunal stays SEBI's 30-Jun final order.
**Zicom Electronic Security Systems** -- NCLAT's 26-Oct order makes any further steps under the impugned insolvency order subject to the appeal's outcome.
other_notable: **Jyothy Labs** -- Board approves a tender-offer buyback of up to 68,37,210 shares (1.86% of equity) at Rs 215, up to Rs 147 cr; record date 11-Nov.
**Cupid** -- long-term exclusive retail partnership with V2 Retail across 425+ stores, targeting Rs 400 cr of incremental annual revenue (the company's own target, not booked).
**Ravindra Energy** -- jointly controlled Energy In Motion signs an MoU with Sorigin Green Mobility to deploy 500 electric heavy commercial vehicles over two years.
**Apis India** -- Board approves listing its existing shares on the NSE main board as well; no fresh capital.
**Jetking Infotrain** -- withdraws its proposal to raise Rs 11.50 cr by issuing 4,60,000 shares at Rs 250 preferentially, approved 21-Jul-2025.
